title: Auth — Passkey Enroll (redeem, start)
description: The invitee presents an auth/passkey/enroll/invite token and its claim code, and the auth service begins the WebAuthn registration ceremony the invite authorises.

token.description: The invite token, as carried in the invite URL.

claimCode.description: The claim code the administrator delivered separately.

Response.title: Auth Passkey Enroll Redeem Start — response payload
Response.description: The registration ceremony the invite authorises.

enrollmentId.description: Opaque handle correlating this start with the matching auth/passkey/enroll/redeem/finish. Echoed verbatim.

subject.description: The VID the invite binds the credential to, so the invitee can see whose passkey they are enrolling before they create it.

purpose.description: What the credential will authenticate, from the invite.

deviceLabel.description: The inviter's suggested label, if any. The invitee MAY override it at finish.

uvOptions.description: PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions over the subject's existing credentials of the same purpose, present exactly when the subject already has one. The invitee MUST run both ceremonies and return both results to finish.

expiresAt.description: When this ceremony lapses (not the invite).
